summary: One-frame request from esv::placement::ExecutionSystem to turn an actor (steering) at the end of a placement; consumed by esv::steering::StateSystem::ProcessBeginRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x9BC9C0) together with the lock:: and trap:: SteeringRequestOneFrameComponents. Seen.py context: dialogues, scripted events and lock/trader interactions where NPCs turn.

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: Storage of ls::Variant<eoc::steering::ToDirection, eoc::steering::ToEntity> (names from the Toolkit's ls::Variant<...>::ValidateAccess used by esv::steering::StateSystem::ProcessBeginRequests, EoCServer.dll+0x9BC9C0): alternative 0 = a direction glm::vec3 (+0..+0xB), alternative 1 = an EntityHandle (+0..+7; the Toolkit checks it for null when the index is 1). Windows writer bg3.exe+0x2F06990 (esv::placement::ExecutionSystem) stores a 16-byte value: the forward vector of the target rotation (quaternion rotated (0,0,1)) at +0..+0xB and 0 at +0xC (alternative 0). Declared as raw dwords because the alternatives overlay each other (the live raw check failed on +4 for an entity alternative).

fields.name: TargetType
fields.evidence: Variant index of Target: Toolkit ProcessBeginRequests tests *(char*)(request+0xC) == 1 (ToEntity) before treating +0 as an entity; Windows creator bg3.exe+0x2F07BC0 zeroes it, the writer stores 0 with the direction.

fields.name: _PadD
fields.evidence: Rest of the variant's 16-byte slot; written as zero together with the index, never read.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Windows creator bg3.exe+0x2F07BC0 writes dword 0 at +0x10; the Toolkit copies the dword at +0x10 when it turns the request into a steering request (puVar19+2). Live 0.

fields.name: _Pad14
fields.evidence: Never written by the creator or the writer, never copied by the Toolkit consumer (which copies +0x10 as a dword, then +0x18 as qwords); live garbage.

fields.name: RequestId
fields.evidence: Windows writer bg3.exe+0x2F06990 stores a freshly generated Guid (FUN_144130D80 twice) at +0x18/+0x20 (also kept in the placement entry +0x38); Toolkit ProcessBeginRequests calls WasAborted(..., (Guid*)(request+0x18)) - matched against SteeringAbortRequestOneFrameComponent. Live: 48 distinct random values.

fields.name: field_28
fields.evidence: Windows creator bg3.exe+0x2F07BC0 default 0x4B18967F (9999999.0f); the placement writer sets 1.5f (0x3FC00000); the Toolkit builds other steering requests with 9999999 then 1.0f. A time limit or speed factor, not established. Live 1.5.

fields.name: _Pad2C
fields.evidence: Not written; tail padding to the 8-byte alignment (the variant may hold an EntityHandle).

open_questions: Meaning of the dword +0x10 and the float +0x28.
second_pass: Windows creator bg3.exe+0x2F07BC0 and writer bg3.exe+0x2F06990 plus the Toolkit consumer esv::steering::StateSystem::ProcessBeginRequests show +0 is ls::Variant<ToDirection, ToEntity> with its index byte at +0xC (declared as raw storage), +0x18 the request Guid checked by WasAborted, +0x10 a dword and +0x28 a float.
raw_check: 48 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
